answer: The lagoon shows someone vouched, the vault shows someone paid, the velvet shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two. Each proof takes 39 minutes of honest labour; 384 proofs take 14976 minutes, and the farm owns no shortcut. No story crosses this threshold, only each tessellated apse is a measured tessera yield plus a guild signature, which is what Medallion layer tessellated apse seal laid upon the basilica requires. The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old.
